description_en: Queries the file systems that can be attached in a region
description_zh: 查询指定地域可挂载的文件系统列表
name: ListAvailableFileSystems

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Page starts from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码。 起始值：1。 默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。 取值范围：1~50。 默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

items.description_en: The information about the file system

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the file system was created

FileSystemId.description_en: The ID of the file system

FileSystemType.description_en:
The type of the file system. Valid values:

standard: general-purpose network-attached storage (NAS) file system
extreme: extreme NAS file system
FileSystemType.description_zh:
文件系统类型。可能值：
standard：通用型 NAS
extreme：极速型 NAS

<props="china">

cpfs：CPFS

</props>

MountTargetList.description_en: The mount targets of the file system

items.description_en: The information about the mount target

MountTargetDomain.description_en: The address of the mount target

NetworkType.description_en:
The network type. Valid values: Valid values:

vpc
NetworkType.description_zh:
网络类型。可能值：
vpc：专有网络

Status.description_en:
The state of the mount target. Valid values:

Active: The mount target is available.
Inactive: The mount target is unavailable.
Pending: The mount target is being mounted.
Deleting: The mount target is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
挂载点状态。可能值：
Active：可用
Inactive：不可用
Pending：挂载中
Deleting：删除中

ProtocolType.description_en:
The protocol type of the file system. Valid values:

nfs
smb
cpfs
ProtocolType.description_zh:
文件系统的协议类型。可能值：
nfs
smb
cpfs

Status.description_en:
The state of the file system. Valid values:

Pending: The file system is processing a task.
Running: The file system is available. You can perform subsequent operations, such as creating a mount target, only when the file system is in the Running state.
Stopped: The file system is unavailable.
Extending: The file system is being scaled out.
Stopping: The file system is being stopped.
Deleting: The file system is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
文件系统状态。可能值：
Pending：当前文件系统正在处理任务中。
Running：当前文件系统可用，当状态为 Running 时才可以进行后续操作（例如：创建挂载点等）。
Stopped：当前文件系统不可用。
Extending：当前文件系统扩容中。
Stopping：当前文件系统停机中。
Deleting：当前文件系统删除中

StorageType.description_en:
The storage type of the file system.

Valid values if FileSystemType is set to standard: Capacity and Performance.
Valid values if FileSystemType is set to extreme: standard and advance
StorageType.description_zh:
存储规格类型。

当FileSystemType为standard时，可能值：Capacity（容量型）、Performance（性能型）
当FileSystemType为extreme时，可能值：standard（标准型）、advance（高级型）
<props="china">
当FileSystemType为CPFS时，可能值：advance_100（100MB/s/TiB基线）、advance_200（200MB/s/TiB基线）</props>

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
